questions.content: Using column chromatography, mixture of two compounds 'A' and 'B' was separated. 'A' eluted first, this indicates 'B' has
questions.explanation:
In column chromatography, the compound that elutes first is the one that is less strongly adsorbed to the stationary phase. Hence, 'A' has weaker adsorption than 'B'. Therefore, 'B' has stronger adsorption.

The retention factor (Rf) is a measure of how much a compound moves up the column; a higher Rf means the compound travels further and is less strongly adsorbed to the stationary phase. Since 'A' elutes first, 'A' has a higher Rf than 'B'. Hence, 'B' has a lower Rf.

So, the correct answer is 'Option D: low Rf, stronger adsorption'.
